47	/** The resolver threw instead of answering: a defect to hand to the next provider, not a fact about one subcomponent. */
48	class ResolverFailureError extends Error {
49	  override name = 'ResolverFailureError'
50	}
51	
52	/** caliper keeps one value per JSDoc tag; Storybook lists every value. */
53	function tagLists(tags: Record<string, string>): Record<string, string[]> | undefined {
54	  const entries = Object.entries(tags)
55	  return entries.length > 0 ? Object.fromEntries(entries.map(([tag, value]) => [tag, [value]])) : undefined
56	}
57	
58	/** Says there is no component `name` in `path`, and which ones the file does have. */
59	function noComponent(session: DocgenSession, name: string, path: string): string {
60	  const names = session.namesIn(path)
61	  const choice = names.length > 0 ? `; its components are ${names.join(', ')}` : ''
62	  return `caliper-docgen found no component ${name} in ${path}${choice}`
63	}
64	
65	export function createDocgenProvider(
66	  options: CaliperStorybookOptions = {},
67	  binding?: SessionBinding,
68	): DocgenMiddleware {
69	  assertValidOptions(options)
70	  const cwd = process.cwd()
71	  const sessionOptions = {
72	    srcDirs: (options.srcDirs ?? ['src']).map((dir) => resolve(cwd, dir)),
73	    exclude: options.exclude,
74	    tsconfigPath: options.tsconfigPath && resolve(cwd, options.tsconfigPath),
75	    skipHtmlProps: options.skipHtmlProps,
76	    htmlAttributes: options.htmlAttributes,
77	    cache: options.cache,
78	    // Richer than Storybook's own docgen by default: caliper-docgen is fast enough to read the dependencies' types.
79	    loadDependencies: options.loadDependencies ?? true,
80	    collapseInheritedProps: options.collapseInheritedProps ?? 'none',
81	    lazy: options.lazy,
82	    warmUp: options.warmUp,
83	    fillAfter: options.fillAfter,
84	    semanticTypes: options.semanticTypes,
85	    tscPath: options.tscPath,
86	    semanticWaitMs: options.semanticWaitMs,
87	  }
88	  // The native binding loads on the first story request, not when Storybook starts the worker.
89	  let sessionPromise: Promise<DocgenSession> | undefined
90	  async function getSession(): Promise<DocgenSession> {
91	    sessionPromise ??= (async () =>
92	      new DocgenSession(sessionOptions, binding ?? (await import('caliper-docgen-napi'))))()
93	    const attempt = sessionPromise
94	    try {
95	      return await attempt
96	    } catch (error) {
97	      // A binding that failed to load is tried again by the next request, not remembered as failed.
98	      if (sessionPromise === attempt) sessionPromise = undefined
99	      throw error
100	    }
101	  }
102	  // A session that cannot start is reported once at a level a developer sees, then every story falls back quietly.
103	  let startFailureReported = false
104	
105	  let started = false
106	  let refreshFailureReported = false
107	
108	  /**
109	   * The session, up to date with the files. A failure before the first successful `fresh()` is a failure to start;
110	   * after it, a failure is a refresh of a running session and is worded as one. Each is reported once until a
111	   * `fresh()` succeeds again, and thrown for the fallback either way.
112	   */
113	  async function freshSession(): Promise<DocgenSession> {
114	    try {
115	      const session = await getSession()
116	      await session.fresh()
117	      started = true
118	      startFailureReported = false
119	      refreshFailureReported = false
120	      return session
121	    } catch (error) {
122	      const { message } = error as Error
123	      if (!started && !startFailureReported) {
124	        startFailureReported = true
125	        logger.warn(`[caliper-docgen] could not start: ${message}; Storybook's own docgen answers instead`)
126	      } else if (started && !refreshFailureReported) {
127	        refreshFailureReported = true
128	        logger.warn(`[caliper-docgen] could not refresh: ${message}; Storybook's own docgen answers instead`)
129	      }
130	      throw error
131	    }
132	  }
133	  const metaComponent = createMetaComponentResolver()
134	  const resolveMeta = (csf: CsfFile, storyPath: string) => {
135	    try {
136	      return metaComponent(csf, storyPath)
137	    } catch (error) {
138	      throw new ResolverFailureError((error as Error).message)
139	    }
140	  }
141	  const fallback = options.fallback ?? 'degraded'
142	  let extractArgTypes: Promise<ExtractArgTypes> | undefined
143	  // A component handed on is reported once, not on every story request that names it.
144	  const reported = new Set<string>()
145	
146	  function reportFallback(key: string, reason: string): void {
147	    if (reported.has(key)) return
148	    reported.add(key)
149	    logger.warn(`[caliper-docgen] ${key}: ${reason}; Storybook's own docgen answers instead`)
150	  }
151	
152	  /** The session key and file `target`'s component points at, or an error that says what the session had instead. */
153	  async function locate(
154	    session: DocgenSession,
155	    target: CsfFile,
156	    storyPath: string,
157	  ): Promise<{ key: string; path: string }> {
158	    const resolution = resolveMeta(target, storyPath)
159	    if ('component' in resolution) {
160	      const { path, exportName, localName } = resolution.component
161	      if (!path) throw new Error(`no file for the import of ${exportName}`)
162	      const key = await session.resolveExport(path, exportName, localName)
163	      if (key) return { key, path }
164	      // Storybook follows `Select.Option` into the module that declares `Option` and answers with that local name, which
165	      // caliper may know as `Select.Option`.
166	      const member = memberComponent(session, target, storyPath)
167	      if (member) return member
168	      throw new Error(noComponent(session, exportName, path))
169	    }
170	    // A member Storybook cannot follow into a module's source (`Select.Option` of a named import from a barrel).
171	    const member = memberComponent(session, target, storyPath)
172	    if (member) return member
173	    throw new Error(`meta.component: ${resolution.reason}`)
174	  }
175	
176	  /** The sub-component a `Namespace.Member` expression names, when `Namespace` is a named or default import. */
177	  function memberComponent(
178	    session: DocgenSession,
179	    csf: CsfFile,
180	    storyPath: string,
181	  ): { key: string; path: string } | undefined {
182	    const node = csf._metaAnnotations.component as
183	      | {
184	          type?: string
185	          computed?: boolean
186	          object?: { type?: string; name?: string }
187	          property?: { type?: string; name?: string }
188	        }
189	      | undefined
190	    if (node?.type !== 'MemberExpression' || node.computed) return undefined
191	    if (node.object?.type !== 'Identifier' || !node.object.name || !node.property?.name) return undefined
192	    const owner = resolveMeta(storyFor(csf, storyPath, node.object.name), storyPath)
193	    if (!('component' in owner) || !owner.component.path) return undefined
194	    const { path, exportName, localName } = owner.component
195	    const key = session.keyOfMember({ exportName, localName }, node.property.name, path)
196	    return key ? { key, path } : undefined
197	  }
198	
199	  /**
200	   * The session key, file and documentation of the component `name` (default: `meta.component`) names, or why there
201	   * is none. The caller has brought the session up to date for this request.
202	   */
203	  async function component(
204	    csf: CsfFile,
205	    storyPath: string,
206	    name?: string,
207	  ): Promise<{ key: string; path: string; doc: RdtComponentDoc }> {
208	    const target = name ? storyFor(csf, storyPath, name) : csf
209	    const session = await getSession()
210	    const { key, path } = await locate(session, target, storyPath)
211	    const { doc, degradedBy } = session.documentation(key)
212	    if (fallback === 'degraded' && degradedBy.length > 0) {
213	      const reason = degradedBy.join('; ')
214	      reportFallback(key, reason)
215	      throw new Error(`${key}'s props may be incomplete: ${reason}`)
216	    }
217	    if (!doc) throw new Error(noComponent(session, key, path))
218	    return { key, path, doc }
219	  }
220	
221	  async function argTypes(doc: RdtComponentDoc): Promise<DocgenPayload['argTypes']> {
222	    extractArgTypes ??= loadExtractArgTypes()
223	    return toArgTypes(doc, await extractArgTypes)
224	  }
225	
226	  async function subcomponent(
227	    { csf, storyPath, importPath }: StoryFile,
228	    { name, componentName }: { name: string; componentName: string },
229	  ): Promise<Subcomponent> {
230	    try {
231	      const { path, doc } = await component(csf, storyPath, componentName)
232	      const { description, summary, jsDocTags } = extractComponentDescription(
233	        undefined,
234	        doc.description || undefined,
235	        tagLists(doc.tags),
236	      )
237	      return { name, path, description, summary, jsDocTags, argTypes: await argTypes(doc) }
238	    } catch (error) {
239	      if (error instanceof ResolverFailureError) throw error
240	      return {
241	        name,
242	        path: importPath,
243	        jsDocTags: {},
244	        error: { name: 'No component import found', message: `${componentName}: ${(error as Error).message}` },
245	      }
246	    }
247	  }
248	
249	  async function document(entry: IndexEntry, importPath: string): Promise<DocgenPayload> {
250	    const storyPath = resolve(cwd, importPath)
251	    const code = await readFile(storyPath, 'utf8')
252	    const csf = loadCsf(code, { fileName: storyPath, makeTitle: () => entry.title }).parse()
253	    // One look at the files for the story and its subcomponents: they are all answered from the same moment.
254	    await freshSession()
255	    const { doc } = await component(csf, storyPath)
256	    const { description, summary, jsDocTags } = extractComponentDescription(
257	      extractDescription(csf._metaStatement, csf.editor) || undefined,
258	      doc.description || undefined,
259	      tagLists(doc.tags),
260	    )
261	    const declared = extractDeclaredSubcomponents(csf)
262	    const subcomponents = Object.fromEntries(
263	      await Promise.all(
264	        declared.map(async (declaration) => [
265	          declaration.name,
266	          await subcomponent({ csf, storyPath, importPath }, declaration),
267	        ]),
268	      ),
269	    )
270	    return {
271	      id: getComponentIdFromEntry(entry),
272	      name: csf._meta?.component ?? entry.title.split('/').at(-1)!.replaceAll(/\s+/g, ''),
273	      path: importPath,
274	      description,
275	      summary,
276	      jsDocTags,
277	      argTypes: await argTypes(doc),
278	      ...(declared.length > 0 ? { subcomponents } : {}),
279	    }
280	  }
281	
282	  return (next) => async (input) => {
283	    const importPath = getStoryImportPathFromEntry(input.entry)
284	    if (!importPath || !STORY_FILE_TEST_REGEXP.test(importPath)) return next(input)
285	    try {
286	      return await document(input.entry, importPath)
287	    } catch (error) {
288	      logger.debug(`[caliper-docgen] ${importPath}: ${(error as Error).message}; asking the next docgen provider`)
289	      return next(input)
290	    }
291	  }
292	}

import type * as Napi from 'caliper-docgen-napi'

export interface SessionOptions {
  /** Absolute source directories. */
  srcDirs: string[]
  exclude?: string[]
  tsconfigPath?: string
  skipHtmlProps?: boolean
  htmlAttributes?: Napi.JsExtractOptions['htmlAttributes']
  /** Read and write the on-disk caches. Default: `true`. */
  cache?: boolean
  loadDependencies?: boolean
  collapseInheritedProps?: Napi.JsExtractOptions['collapseInheritedProps']
  /**
   * Resolve a component when a story asks for it rather than every component at start. Default: `true`. The answers
   * are the same; a session that serves a few components of many starts and holds less.
   */
  lazy?: boolean
  /**
   * After a lazy session starts, resolve a few components in the background so the dependency declarations and memos
   * the stories share are loaded before the first one asks. Default: `false`: measured against the same stories, it
   * did not make the first story faster, because the warm-up and the story compete for the same threads.
   */
  warmUp?: boolean
  /**
   * Once this many distinct components were asked for, resolve the rest in one background pass. Default: `0`, never:
   * it lowers the median story latency but raises peak memory by 170 to 420 MB.
   */
  fillAfter?: number
  /**
   * Ask TypeScript's 7.1 checker for each component a story names (experimental). `'off'` (the default) never starts
   * it; `'on-demand'` keeps one `tsc` warm, asks it for exactly the requested component, and takes the structural
   * props when it is slower than `semanticWaitMs`. Needs `typescript@beta` installed, or `tscPath`.
   */
  semanticTypes?: Napi.JsExtractOptions['semanticTypes']
  /** The `tsc` binary to run, instead of the nearest `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc` or `node_modules/tsrs/bin/tsrs`. */
  tscPath?: string
  /** How many milliseconds a story waits for the checker before it takes the structural props. Default: `150`. */
  semanticWaitMs?: number
}

[workspace]
members = [
    "crates/core",
    "crates/binding",
    "crates/cli",
    "crates/tsc-client",
    "crates/semantic",
]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.99"
authors = ["caliper-docgen contributors"]
license = "FSL-1.1-MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/orin-dx/caliper"
homepage = "https://orin-dx.com/tools/caliper/"
keywords = ["react", "docgen", "typescript", "oxc", "storybook"]
categories = ["development-tools", "command-line-utilities"]

# "deny" rather than "forbid": a member crate could locally #[allow(unsafe_code)]
# on a real FFI boundary if one ever needs it — none currently do (verified:
# zero `unsafe` usage across crates/core, crates/cli, crates/binding; napi-rs's
# #[napi] macros generate the FFI glue without user-visible unsafe).
[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "deny"
unused_must_use = "deny"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
all = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
unwrap_used = "deny"
expect_used = "deny"
panic = "deny"
dbg_macro = "deny"
# Only `main` ends the process, so a command's exit decision stays testable; the one other exit is allowed in place.
exit = "deny"
print_stdout = "deny"
print_stderr = "deny"
map_err_ignore = "deny"
let_underscore_must_use = "deny"

[workspace.dependencies]
# OXC — all main crates move in lockstep; resolver has separate versioning
oxc_allocator     = "0.157"
oxc_parser        = "0.157"
oxc_ast           = "0.157"
oxc_ast_visit     = "0.157"
oxc_span          = "0.157"
oxc_str           = "0.157"
oxc_syntax        = "0.157"
oxc_resolver      = "11"

# Core data
compact_str       = { version = "0.10", features = ["serde"] }
rustc-hash        = "2.1"
dashmap           = "6.1"
arc-swap          = "1.9"
camino            = { version = "1.2", features = ["serde1"] }

# Serde
serde             = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive", "rc"] }
serde_json        = "1.0"
json-strip-comments = "3.1"
rmp-serde         = "1.3"

# Error handling
miette            = "7.6"

# Parallelism
rayon             = "1.12"
mimalloc          = "0.1"
tokio             = { version = "1.52", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "process", "io-util", "sync", "macros"] }

# File system
ignore            = "0.4"

# CLI
clap              = { version = "4.6", features = ["derive", "env", "wrap_help"] }
clap_complete     = "4.6"

18:[dependencies]
23:serde_json                = { workspace = true, features = ["raw_value"] }
24:camino.workspace          = true
25:tracing.workspace         = true
28:[dev-dependencies]

23	const pty = await call('getTypeOfSymbol', { ...sc, symbol: param.reference ?? param.id })

28	const mapped = new Map() // type id -> info
29	const seen = new Set()
30	async function walk(t, depth) {
31	  if (!t || seen.has(t.id) || depth > 4) return

42	let [propsMs, propsBytes, propsCount, consMs, consBytes] = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
43	const constraints = new Map()
44	let sample
45	for (const [id] of mapped) {
46	  s = performance.now()
47	  const list = await call('getPropertiesOfType', { ...sc, type: id })
48	  propsMs += performance.now() - s
49	  propsBytes += bytes(list)
50	  propsCount += list.length
51	  s = performance.now()
52	  const c = await call('getConstraintTypeOfMappedType', { ...sc, objectId: id })
53	  const n = await call('getNameTypeOfMappedType', { ...sc, objectId: id })
54	  consMs += performance.now() - s
55	  consBytes += bytes(c) + bytes(n)
56	  const key = c?.id
57	  if (!constraints.has(key)) constraints.set(key, { c, n, count: list.length, decl: list[0]?.declarations?.[0] })
58	  else if (constraints.get(key).count !== list.length) console.log('MISMATCH: same constraint, different count', key)
59	  sample ??= { info: mapped.get(id), list0: list[0], c, n }
60	}
61	console.log('getPropertiesOfType over them: ms', propsMs.toFixed(1), 'bytes', propsBytes, 'properties', propsCount)
62	console.log('constraint+nameType over them: ms', consMs.toFixed(1), 'bytes', consBytes)
63	console.log('distinct constraint types', constraints.size)
64	for (const [key, v] of constraints) {
65	  s = performance.now()
66	  const members = v.c && v.c.flags & 134217728 ? await call('getTypesOfType', { ...sc, objectId: v.c.id }) : null
67	  console.log(' constraint', key, 'flags', v.c?.flags, 'nameType', v.n?.id ?? null, 'props', v.count,
68	    'union members', members?.length ?? '-', 'ms', (performance.now() - s).toFixed(1), 'first decl', v.decl)
